activity_summary: At the door you were Egeon, who opens the play and waits. You did not rewrite the speech on the way in. Nobody named a sum. You played, and the middle of it did not need you.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a new sentence, and went on.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named the shape of the part, and refused a figure.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Sent you off until the close.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Kept the twins for the middle.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Egeon, and then he waits

facets.activity: Played Egeon and waited through the middle

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: You open it. The play goes on without you until the close

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not improving it in a doorway
